description_context: MiniGrid KeyCorridor S6R3: the agent explores the side rooms off a corridor, finds the key of the locked door, unlocks it and picks up the ball behind it. An episode ends on the pickup or at the step limit.
reconstruction_note: No authentic prompt exists for this environment: the DoorKey templates carry our environment bullets, mission and stage chain (paper A.2.1).
mission: The agent must explore the side rooms of the corridor, find the key that matches the locked door, unlock the door, and pick up the ball behind it.
